name: Color Soul 2: Nightfall
detailed_description:
Fight Enemies in Action

In this bullet-hell style action RPG, you don't take turns. Rather, correct timing is needed to know when to strike. After all, the enemy can't keep attacking forever. Utilize various spells in battle to keep your foes on their toes.

Unlock the World's Colors

After a certain point in the game, the world's color will be stripped away. Restore the colors through each of the 8 color-coded areas In order to complete your main quest.

Play Minigames

Take a break from combat with a variety of mini games! Tile puzzles, fishing, and more await to always keep things fresh.

Discover Secrets

Many secrets are waiting for you to discover. How many? More than one I'm sure! 

Color Soul 2: Nightfall is a sequel game set six months after the events of Color Soul: Memories. With a full soundtrack, unique simplified art style, color mechanics, and 8 color-coded areas to explore, this game is sure to set itself apart and make an impression. Beware the Nightfall.

short_description: Set six months after the events of Color Soul: Memories, you must fulfill your newly discovered purpose and fight against the coming darkness in this action RPG. Combat enemies, unlock the colors of the world, and play minigames as you try to stop the world's end.
